DGE hippomcapus analysis

Setup

library(readr)
library(glue)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(readxl)


project_dir <- "~/Documents/repos/explant-seq"
rna_dir <- glue("{project_dir}/data/RNA/RNA-preprocessed")
patients <- c("EXP001", "EXP003", "EXP006", "EXP007")

# read in electrode metadata
electrode_metadata <- patients %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map_dfr(~ read_excel(glue("{project_dir}/data/metadata/{.x}_electrode_metadata.xlsx")),
          .id = "subject")
meta <- electrode_metadata[!is.na(electrode_metadata$hippocampus), ]

# read in raw counts
raw_counts <- read.table(
  glue("{rna_dir}/260601_exp001-007/feature_counts/featurecounts.readcounts.raw.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
colnames(raw_counts) <- gsub("alignment.(.*?).srt.bam", "\\1", colnames(raw_counts))

cols <- c(meta$sample_id, "Geneid")
raw_counts <- raw_counts[, (names(raw_counts) %in% cols)]
library(DESeq2)
library(tibble)

# ensure electrode metadata rows match raw_counts
raw_counts <- column_to_rownames(raw_counts, var = "Geneid")
meta <- meta[match(colnames(raw_counts), meta$sample_id), ]
all(colnames(raw_counts) == meta$sample_id)
## [1] TRUE
meta$hippocampus <- factor(meta$hippocampus, levels = c("contralateral", "implicated")) # contralateral as baseline)
meta$subject <- factor(meta$subject)

# create DESeq2 object
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = raw_counts,
  colData = meta,
  design = ~ subject + hippocampus
)

# filter to remove genes with very low counts (keeps genes with >10 counts in >4 samples)
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 4
dds <- dds[keep, ]

# run DESeq2
dds <- DESeq(dds)
## estimating size factors
## estimating dispersions
## gene-wise dispersion estimates
## mean-dispersion relationship
## final dispersion estimates
## fitting model and testing
resultsNames(dds)
## [1] "Intercept"                               "subject_EXP003_vs_EXP001"                "subject_EXP006_vs_EXP001"                "subject_EXP007_vs_EXP001"               
## [5] "hippocampus_implicated_vs_contralateral"
res <- results(dds, name = "hippocampus_implicated_vs_contralateral", alpha = 0.1)
summary(res)
## 
## out of 10898 with nonzero total read count
## adjusted p-value < 0.1
## LFC > 0 (up)       : 4, 0.037%
## LFC < 0 (down)     : 7, 0.064%
## outliers [1]       : 0, 0%
## low counts [2]     : 4648, 43%
## (mean count < 57)
## [1] see 'cooksCutoff' argument of ?results
## [2] see 'independentFiltering' argument of ?results
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ensembl_gene_id") %>%
  arrange(padj)

head(res_df)
##   ensembl_gene_id   baseMean log2FoldChange     lfcSE      stat       pvalue       padj
## 1 ENSG00000213178  193.95320     -1.4750182 0.3395959 -4.343451 1.402618e-05 0.08766362
## 2 ENSG00000122224   75.38111     -1.5162200 0.3872336 -3.915517 9.021063e-05 0.09685413
## 3 ENSG00000136689 6468.80153     -0.6922836 0.1776483 -3.896933 9.741846e-05 0.09685413
## 4 ENSG00000185641  159.82230     -1.5241474 0.3714146 -4.103628 4.067211e-05 0.09685413
## 5 ENSG00000106638  154.32429     -1.0382357 0.2705054 -3.838133 1.239733e-04 0.09685413
## 6 ENSG00000105894   87.80573      1.8878455 0.4736551  3.985697 6.728236e-05 0.09685413
library(biomaRt)

mart <- useMart("ensembl", 
                dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

annot <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol"),
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values = res_df$ensembl_gene_id,
  mart = mart
)

res_df <- annot %>% left_join(res_df, by = "ensembl_gene_id")
res_df <- res_df[order(res_df$pvalue), ]
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# define significance thresholds
lfc_thresh <- 1
p_thresh <- 0.001

# categorise genes
res_df <- res_df %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(pvalue < p_thresh & log2FoldChange > lfc_thresh  ~ "Up",
                             pvalue < p_thresh & log2FoldChange < -lfc_thresh ~ "Down" , 
                             TRUE ~ "NS"),
    significance = factor(significance, levels = c("Up", "Down", "NS"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(hgnc_symbol) & hgnc_symbol != "") %>%
  filter(!is.na(pvalue)) %>%
  mutate(fc_pval_rank = sign(log2FoldChange) * -log10(pvalue)) %>%
  arrange(desc(fc_pval_rank))


# select top genes to label
label_genes <- res_df %>%
  filter(pvalue < p_thresh) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(pvalue), colour = significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = filter(res_df, significance != "NS"), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_thresh, lfc_thresh), 
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(max(res_df$pvalue[res_df$pvalue < p_thresh], na.rm = TRUE)),
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_genes,
    aes(label = hgnc_symbol),
    size = 3.5,
    max.overlaps = 20,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    colour = "black") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Up" = "#E64B35", "Down" = "#4DBBD5", "NS" = "grey70")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-4, 4)) +
  labs(title = "Contralateral vs Implicated Hippocampus", x = "log2FC", y = "-log10(pval)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

GSEA

library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(dplyr)

head(res_df)
##   ensembl_gene_id hgnc_symbol  baseMean log2FoldChange     lfcSE     stat       pvalue       padj significance fc_pval_rank
## 1 ENSG00000138755       CXCL9  39.31025      2.5071414 0.5819705 4.308022 1.647212e-05         NA           Up     4.783250
## 2 ENSG00000105894         PTN  87.80573      1.8878455 0.4736551 3.985697 6.728236e-05 0.09685413           Up     4.172099
## 3 ENSG00000165795       NDRG2 193.32854      0.9645729 0.2494555 3.866713 1.103122e-04 0.09685413           NS     3.957376
## 4 ENSG00000139631        CSAD  16.65166      3.8918813 1.0255627 3.794874 1.477184e-04         NA           Up     3.830566
## 5 ENSG00000117616       RSRP1 105.78772      1.2422264 0.3280428 3.786782 1.526111e-04 0.09735896           Up     3.816414
## 6 ENSG00000130164        LDLR  95.78346      1.6855933 0.4485477 3.757891 1.713518e-04 0.09735896           Up     3.766111
ranked_list <- res_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(fc_pval_rank)) %>%
  arrange(desc(fc_pval_rank)) %>%
  # convert HGNC to Entrez ID
  left_join(
    bitr(res_df$hgnc_symbol, 
         fromType = "SYMBOL",
         toType = "ENTREZID",
         OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db),
    by = c("hgnc_symbol" = "SYMBOL")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ENTREZID)) %>%
  # remove duplicate entrez IDs keeping highest absolute rank
  arrange(desc(abs(fc_pval_rank))) %>%
  filter(!duplicated(ENTREZID)) %>%
  # create named vector for GSEA
  { setNames(.$fc_pval_rank, .$ENTREZID) } %>%
  sort(decreasing = TRUE)
## 'select()' returned 1:1 mapping between keys and columns
## Warning in bitr(res_df$hgnc_symbol, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", : 0.3% of input gene IDs are fail to map...
gsea_go <- gseGO(
  geneList     = ranked_list,
  OrgDb        = org.Hs.eg.db,
  ont          = "BP",
  minGSSize    = 15,
  maxGSSize    = 500,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  verbose      = TRUE,
  seed         = 42
)
## using 'fgsea' for GSEA analysis, please cite Korotkevich et al (2019).
## preparing geneSet collections...
## GSEA analysis...

## leading edge analysis...
## done...
# simplify redundant GO terms (cutoff = similarity threshold)
gsea_go_simplified <- simplify(gsea_go, cutoff = 0.5, by = "p.adjust", select_fun = min)
as.data.frame(gsea_go_simplified)

# Plot

  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Suppressed in SOZ HA" = "#4647AE", "Enriched in SOZ HA" = "#34908B")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "GSEA GO Biological Process",
    x     = "Normalised Enrichment Score (NES)",
    y     = NULL,
    fill  = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

Implicated hippocampi were enriched in pathways related to cholesterol biosynthesis (higher cholesterol can contribute to enhanced glutamatergic transmission), skeletal system morphogenesis and defence to virus (see leading edge genes below).

print_leading_genes <- function(go_id){
  leading_genes <- gsea_go@result[go_id, "core_enrichment"]
  gene_info <- bitr(
    strsplit(leading_genes, split = "/")[[1]],
    fromType = "ENTREZID",
    toType   = c("SYMBOL", "GENENAME"),
    OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
  )
  print(gene_info)
}

Skeletal system morphogenesis really relates to extracellular matrix remodelling genes, that includes matrix metallopeptidases, collagens, hyaluronidase etc. Interesting is histone lysine methyltransferase which is an epigenetic regulator - the ECM changes might be more long-term than just acute. MEF2C is an important regulator of synaptic pruning.

This GO term might reflect increased sterile neuroinflammation in the implicated hippocampus rather than defence response to virus: - damaged/stressed cells release damage-associated molecular patterns (DAMPs) - these are recognised by innate immune sensors such as cGAS, TLR3 (double stranded RNA), ZBP1 (left-handed DNA, RNA) - this then results in type I interferon response (STAT1, STAT2, IRF1, IFNAR2, IKBKE) - TRIM family ubiquitin ligases are interferon-stimulated genes
